nld_girl_with_a_pearl_earring.webp.note: Background extended with dark fill; the turban's blue band shows blocky, pixelated brushwork, and the craquelure is smoother than in the original.

pol_lady_with_an_ermine.webp.note: Image 2 is the same painting, extended on the dark background to fill the square with no visible seam. The original's top-left inscription is removed.

fra_the_thinker.webp.note: Sculpture is the same, shown from a different angle and setting (garden, not the original's office-building backdrop). Pedestal differs, but no seams or distortion.

vat_piet.webp.note: Sculpture, not a painting; background changed from marble wall to dark blue niche, plinth altered, but the artwork is intact and unstretched.

prt_porto_s_o_bento_azulejo_panels.webp.note: Image 1 shows the station exterior, not an azulejo panel. Image 2 is a tile panel with a cornice and yellow tile border, so it is not the same artwork.

fra_mona_lisa.webp.note: Composition altered: figure smaller, landscape extended, hands and a new balustrade post added, face and proportions changed. Extended areas are AI-generated, not original.

usa_the_starry_night.webp.note: Composition matches, but the image looks stretched to a square, and the bottom has an added dark strip of extended foreground with a visible seam.

ita_the_last_supper.webp.note: Image 2 extends beyond the painting: it adds lunettes with coats of arms above and an invented tiled floor below, so it is not edge to edge.

ita_the_birth_of_venus.webp.note: Figures are repositioned and rescaled, the Venus pose and Zephyr group are altered, and the sky and sea are extended or regenerated. The sea has visible inconsistencies, and the figures look squashed.

vat_the_creation_of_adam.webp.note: Sky and hillside were extended to fill the square in matching fresco style. The figures are intact, with no seams, borders or stretching.

aut_the_kiss.webp.note: Image 2 repaints the work: the flower meadow is stylized differently, the dress patterns and faces are altered, and the signature is garbled. It is a copy, not the original.

deu_wanderer_above_the_sea_of_fog.webp.note: Image 2 is horizontally mirrored: spire, mountain, rocks and cane are on opposite sides compared with the original.

vat_school_of_athens.webp.note: Looks like an AI-regenerated version: faces, poses and details differ from the original, and figures are rearranged, e.g. the foreground figures and statue details.

gbr_sunflowers.webp.note: Different composition: flowers rearranged, background is yellow rather than light blue, and the vase lacks the original shape and shading. It is a new painting in the same style.

usa_irises.webp.note: Looks like an AI-style reinterpretation: iris placement differs, background changed from green to yellow-gold, and the soil is more orange. Signature is missing.

nld_caf_terrace_at_night.webp.note: Looks like an AI re-creation: stars became daisy-like flowers, the figures on the right and the street details differ, and the brushwork and composition are altered.

bel_the_fall_of_icarus.webp.note: Composition differs: ship, rocks, figures, and shepherd are rearranged; the original's legs of Icarus are replaced by swimmers, and the fisherman is changed. It is a repainted variant, not the original.

gbr_the_hay_wain.webp.note: Different composition: the cart is moved and reversed, the horses are rearranged, and a white horse is added. A woman, a figure in the doorway, a fence and a stump are also new.

gbr_happy_accident_on_the_swing.webp.note: Composition differs: the old man moved to the upper left, the cherub statue to the right, and the palette changed from cool blue-green to warm golden. It is a re-imagining, not the original.

usa_luncheon_of_the_boating_party.webp.note: Composition altered: figures rearranged, right side compressed, foreground extended with invented brown/blue brushwork; the bottom looks like water and is not in the original.

esp_the_third_of_may_1808.webp.note: Figures, poses and faces are repainted differently: the firing squad is rearranged, the soldiers' arms and rifles are altered, and the sky is extended. It reads as a reinterpretation, not the original.

fra_olympia.webp.note: Composition altered: cat moved from the right onto the floor, the background is extended and much darker, the bouquet is changed, and the bed, shawl and pose differ.

usa_the_great_wave_of_kanagawa.webp.note: Looks like an AI-style recreation: sky changed to yellow with added clouds, wave details and boat positions differ, colour scheme not faithful. Cartouche and signature removed.

nld_almond_blossom.webp.note: Image 2 is a new imitation: different branch layout, flowers larger and more saturated, much more vivid cyan than the original's muted teal.

can_massacre_of_the_innocents.webp.note: Different composition: figures, buildings, tree and horses are rearranged, with a frozen stream and dead infants added. It looks like a new painting in Bruegel's style, not a reproduction.

nor_the_scream.webp.note: Not the original: brushwork is Van Gogh-like and colours differ. Two background figures are now men in hats, and a boat and a building are added.

usa_american_gothic.webp.note: Looks like an AI-regenerated imitation: details differ (house, porch, window, pitchfork, proportions). Lawn extended at left and bottom, with no original signature.

usa_a_sunday_afternoon_on_the_island_of_.note: Figures are rearranged and altered: the monkey and dog are moved, the left-side figures and fishing woman are changed, and the red-dressed lady and trumpeter are repositioned. The composition is only a loose imitation.

fra_self_portrait.webp.note: Image 2 shows a different painting: an older man with arms folded, in a different pose and composition. Image 1 is a young man in a dark beret, lit from the left.

fra_the_bridge_at_narni.webp.note: Different composition: hilltop town, a single large arch, and a second arch on the right are invented. A donkey and rider are added. Colours and layout differ.

fra_the_starry_night_over_the_rhone.webp.note: Image 2 is a regenerated look-alike: the brushwork differs, the stars and reflections are redrawn, the boats are repositioned, and the shoreline and sky details do not match the original.

usa_dogs_playing_poker.webp.note: Different composition: dark room with lamp and round table, not the train carriage scene. Figures, poses, colours and setting differ; it is a new painting.

fra_arrangement_in_grey_and_black_no_1.w.note: Composition differs: curtain moved from left to right and is plain cream instead of dark floral. The figure, framed picture and proportions are also altered, so this is a re-imagining, not the original.

esp_the_garden_of_earthly_delights.webp.note: Figures and details are redrawn and differ from the original; a new strawberry strip was added at the bottom, and the panels look stretched.

gbr_the_ambassadors.webp.note: Crucifix added top-left; tablecloth recoloured from red to green; table objects altered; composition regenerated rather than faithfully reproduced.

usa_the_night_caf.webp.note: Composition differs: clock, doorway, figures, tables and lamps are rearranged and the room is redrawn. It is an AI re-imagining, not the original. Signature is missing.

fra_impression_sunrise.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: sun, boats, ships, and smokestacks are rearranged, with a bluer palette and extra figures. The signature is missing.

gbr_the_fighting_temeraire.webp.note: Sky appears extended/regenerated with repainted brushwork; minor detail differences (buoy chain, distant ships) from original, but composition matches.

usa_saint_george_and_the_dragon.webp.note: Composition mirrored and rearranged: knight left, lady right in cave, dragon pose differs, added castle hill, flower field, red plume. Different painting.

ita_annunciation.webp.note: Composition altered: the building is redrawn with a cornice and brick wall, the lectern changed, and the Virgin repositioned. Added sky and foreground are AI-generated, not original.

usa_breezing_up.webp.note: Different composition: three figures instead of four, no 'GLOUCESTER' hull text, added island on horizon, different boat and palette; looks like a new painting.

gbr_the_ladies_waldegrave.webp.note: Different painting: figures' poses, hairstyles (no powdered grey hair), table, sewing activity, and background (no window or landscape) differ from the original.

fra_et_in_arcadia_ego.webp.note: Different composition: two curly-haired youths lean over a stone block with skull; original has figures behind tree, owl, inscription, landscape. Inscription missing.

usa_the_avenue_in_the_rain.webp.note: Different composition: a street scene with a vanishing point, a carriage and small figures, muted purple palette. The original is a vertical close-up of flags with umbrellas.

fra_madame_recamier.webp.note: Composition is mirrored: figure, couch and lamp are flipped. Lamp is now lit, the footstool is simpler, and the extended square background looks regenerated.

fra_patrocles.webp.note: Completely different composition: image 2 shows many armored mourners around a laid-out body, a pyre and sea, instead of a single seated nude seen from behind.

fra_napoleon_crossing_the_alps.webp.note: Colour scheme differs: the horse is brown instead of white-grey and the cloak is ochre instead of red. The inscriptions are garbled, so it is a reinterpretation, not the same work.

ita_narcissus.webp.note: Image 2 is an outpainted extension: the dark background was expanded on the sides and top, so the figure appears smaller, with altered reflection details.

usa_the_sleeping_gypsy.webp.note: Looks like an AI re-creation, not the original: lion, sleeper, mandolin and jug are redrawn and repositioned, with more stars and a different moon and palette.

fra_the_gleaners.webp.note: Colour scheme is much warmer and more golden than the original's muted greens and greys. Background details differ: a horseman is more prominent and the village is replaced by haystacks.

ita_primavera.webp.note: Bottom of the square was extended with generated flower meadow; a visible seam appears near y≈850, and the figures look slightly stretched.

nld_wheatfield_with_crows.webp.note: Sky is much darker with added swirls; clouds, crow positions and path shape differ from the original. It is a reinterpretation, not the same composition.

aut_the_tower_of_babel.webp.note: Looks like a reinterpretation, not the original. The tower's shape, the foreground figures, the king's group, the ships and the landscape differ, and the colours are warmer.

fra_a_cotton_office_in_new_orleans.webp.note: Different composition: figures, furniture and room layout are rearranged, and a ledger-writing clerks' desk is new. It is a reinterpretation, not Degas's painting.

gbr_bacchus_and_ariadne.webp.note: Different composition: Bacchus pose, figures, and the star ring differ; the cheetahs, satyrs, and Silenus on a donkey are rearranged, and the Ariadne figure is changed. It is a re-imagining, not the original.

usa_the_gross_clinic.webp.note: Composition differs: figures rearranged, the patient's leg is replaced by a torso, the woman's pose is changed, the red wall is gone and the palette is darker. The Eakins signature is missing.

fra_the_astronomer.webp.note: Looks like an AI recreation: the globe, robe color (green vs blue-gray), clock and drapery details, and the chair differ from the original. The extended composition is not faithful.

usa_paris_street_in_rainy_weather.webp.note: Image 2 is a re-creation: buildings, figures and lamppost are rearranged, a man carrying a parcel is added, and the signature is missing.

fra_water_lilies.webp.note: Composition differs: image 2 has a blue sky-cloud reflection and many small lilies, while the original shows a few large pads and two pink blossoms.

che_composition_with_red_blue_and_yellow.note: Lower-right detail altered: original has small white cell and black bar above the yellow; reproduction has only a tall yellow cell. Signature missing.

are_salvator_mundi.webp.note: Image 2 is a different rendering: the sphere, hand and drapery differ, and the face and colour tone are altered. It looks regenerated and extends the dark background.

usa_the_peaceable_kingdom.webp.note: Different composition: animals regrouped on left, river and figures on right, added bear and calf. Original's text border, ship and treaty scene are missing.

rus_the_ninth_wave.webp.note: Colour scheme differs strongly: the original has pale yellow-pink-purple skies, the copy is saturated orange-red. The raft is larger and the figures are rearranged and redrawn.

gbr_mr_and_mrs_andrews.webp.note: Composition rearranged: figures repositioned, brighter sky instead of stormy, bench, gun and wheat sheaves differ, church added, sheep changed; signature-like marks added at bottom corners.

usa_pollice_verso.webp.note: Different composition: a single gladiator stands over a fallen foe, with no emperor's box, hanging carpets or second body. It is a new AI-style painting, not the original.

fra_the_embarkation_to_cythera.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: the figures, boat with canopy, statue position and cherubs are rearranged and redrawn, not Watteau's original.

gbr_a_bar_at_the_folies_berg_re.webp.note: Looks like an AI regeneration, not the original: the man on the right is cropped out, the trapeze legs are altered, and the details differ. The extended marble counter looks synthetic.

gbr_the_laughing_cavalier.webp.note: Different painting: hat, collar, pose, costume embroidery and composition differ from the original; the sash, large ruff and inscription are missing. It looks like a generated imitation.

deu_the_fox.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: a single curled sleeping fox on blue, green and purple facets, not Marc's two red foxes. Palette differs.

fra_the_card_players.webp.note: Image 2 is a different version: figures, hats, bottle, cards and table are redrawn with a duller palette. The extended areas look synthesized.

usa_the_grand_canal_venice.webp.note: Different composition: church, buildings, boats and gondolas rearranged; warmer golden palette, not Turner's original. Adds a signature at bottom right and new figures.

gbr_a_boat_passing_a_lock.webp.note: Different composition: a central sailboat, a cottage, a white horse and a footbridge replace the original's lock gate, lad, dog and stormy sky. Palette and brushwork differ, and a signature was added.

ita_sacred_and_profane_love.webp.note: Reproduction is a reinterpretation: figures' poses and gazes differ, lamp replaces the bowl, added fountain spout, rider, sheep, wings and veil; the landscape is altered and stretched.

gbr_the_ancient_of_days.webp.note: Looks like an AI-made reimagining, not the original. The figure, face, clouds, sun, compass and colours are redrawn, with a more orange palette and engraving-style hatching.

mlt_the_beheading_of_saint_john_the_bapt.note: Different composition: figures rearranged, seated robed man added, executioner's pose changed, arch and rope missing, prisoners' window moved. Looks like a reinterpretation, not the original.

rus_the_return_of_the_prodigal_son.webp.note: Figures are repainted and rearranged. The two background figures (woman at left, smiling face at center) are gone, replaced by a carved head; faces and details differ. It is a regeneration, not the original.

usa_christ_carrying_the_cross.webp.note: Faces, expressions and figure placement differ from the original (e.g. central screaming figure, top-left figure, lower-left woman); looks like another version or regeneration.

ita_deposition_from_the_cross.webp.note: Different composition: figures, poses, ladders and colours differ from Rosso Fiorentino's original; the scene is a new AI-style rendition with added rocky hill and new figures.

fra_the_luncheon_on_the_grass.webp.note: Image 1 is a charcoal sketch on grey paper with a different composition; image 2 is Monet's finished color painting, not the same work.

fra_dance_at_le_moulin_de_la_galette.web.note: Image 2 is a different composition: figures, positions and poses are rearranged, so it is a new painting in the same style. It adds new people.

ita_the_calling_of_st_matthew.webp.note: Image 2 is the Caravaggio composition, but it appears horizontally squeezed (figures look narrower) with darker, yellower colour and extended dark floor and wall areas.

fra_grande_odalisque.webp.note: Different composition: figure pose, peacock fan, hookah, pillows and drapery are rearranged. It is a new AI-style painting, not Ingres' Grande Odalisque.

rus_dance_ii.webp.note: Figures are redrawn with different poses, faces and hair; colours are cleaner and more saturated, and the brushwork is smoother. The hill and sky were extended and regenerated, not cropped. This is a reinterpretation, not the original.

nld_the_milkmaid.webp.note: Image 2 is an AI-style regeneration, not the original: the composition is extended sideways with new wall, and details like the tiles, bread and window differ.

fra_venus_de_milo.webp.note: Image 2 looks like an AI recreation: the head is turned the opposite way, the drapery is rearranged, the marble looks more yellow, and the base is round rather than rectangular.

deu_nefertiti_bust.webp.note: Image 2 is a frontal AI-style recreation, not the original angled view. Both eyes are inlaid, whereas the original's left eye is empty. The headband, collar and face details differ. The gray studio background means it is not edge-to-edge.

ita_ecstasy_of_saint_teresa.webp.note: Surrounding marble is reddish-brown with different columns and a pediment, unlike the original's green marble. The angel's arrow is missing, the crucifix and candles are gone, and the rays differ. The extended area looks AI-generated.

usa_composition_viii.webp.note: Image 2 is a different composition: shapes, colors and positions are rearranged (e.g. pink and olive circles, blue triangle, squiggle). It is an AI imitation, not a reproduction.

ita_apollo_and_daphne.webp.note: Image 2 is a different AI-generated rendition: Apollo's pose, drapery and Daphne's arms differ from Bernini's original. It also shows a plain studio backdrop instead of the Borghese room.

ita_discobolus.webp.note: Image 2 is a re-rendering, not the original: base differs, tree stump is shifted and reshaped, head and face are changed, and the sculpture is a different marble shade.

fra_psyche_revived_by_cupid_s_kiss.webp.note: Image 2 looks like an AI-regenerated version: Psyche's head and arms and Cupid's pose differ, and the base is altered. It is a sculpture on a plain studio background.
